about: Games that build all their shaders and pipelines at the main menu or a loading screen, so their in-game stutter isn't shader compilation and SCSKiller can't help: they show as Unsupported. Only entries with a real source (an https link). ids are Game.Id values (steam:<appid>, xbox:<package family>, epic:<app name>, ea:<content id>), the only match; name is for people. date = when the entry was last checked. Embedded in the app and served at /v1/content/precompiles-at-boot.json, the same file; the app uses the served copy when it passes BootPrecompiles.TryParse.
